Title: MediaWiki Style Service Upgrade
Author: Jane Doe <jane@example.com>
Posted: 2026-02-11
Revision: 1
News-Item-Format: 2.0
Display-If-Installed: sys-auth/example-sssd

== Systemd users ==

Stop the service before upgrading >=sys-auth/example-sssd-2.10:

  systemctl stop example-sssd

== OpenRC users ===

Restart via rc-service after updating permissions.
